_eajmusicNotes.backendEventSource: eajmusic-api src/routes/public.js — POST /public/testimonials/:artistSlug fires this after creating a PENDING testimonial (fire-and-forget, never blocks the submitter's response).
_eajmusicNotes.envVarNeeded: N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL on the backend must point here, e.g. https://n8n.eajmusic.com/webhook (production) — the path suffix /testimonial-submitted is appended automatically by the backend.
beforeActivating: 1. Create a Telegram credential in n8n (Credentials > New > Telegram API) using a bot token from @BotFather. Do not paste the token anywhere else.
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_N8N_CREDENTIAL_ID with that credential's id after importing.
3. Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID with your personal or group chat id (send /start to your bot, then check https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates to find it).
4. After import, n8n assigns a real webhookId automatically — no action needed there.
5. Toggle the workflow Active once verified.
